about: Token rules and planner constants. Edit this file, not data/rules.json (which is generated with verification results).
lateWindowRunsPastDeadline: assumed: activating before the deadline gives the full 14 days. Not confirmed by Epic; you can switch it off on the page.
statusRules: announced: one of the event's keywords appears in Epic's in-game news (fortnite-api.com /v2/news/br) on the latest run.
confirmed / reported: at least one listed source page was reachable and still contains every required phrase; the claim level is the curator's label for that source.
pattern: the date is projected from past years; it keeps this label whether or not its reference page verifies.
unverified: a confirmed/reported claim whose sources could not be reached or no longer contain the required phrases.

fallbacks.baselineNote: Used only until the site has collected its own snapshots. Rough author estimate of V-Bucks of brand-new offers per normal shop day, by type.
fallbacks.survivalAbout: Share of new-offer V-Bucks still in the shop j days after arriving, measured on the archive May-Nov 2026. Used until data/baseline.json has its own curve.

facts.text: Access lasts 14 days from the moment you press Activate.
The 2026 access must be activated by Dec 15, 2026.
Real-money offers, gifting and Battle Pass levels are not included.
Only one Sidekick you don't already own can be claimed.
The Item Shop resets at 00:00 UTC.
A second activation can be used from Jan 1, 2027.

uncertainty.about: Settings for the simulated futures behind the ranges. runs/seed/eventsSpreads are the author's choices. daySpread, weekdayWeight and nearTol were chosen by back-testing on the past-shop archive (May-Nov 2026): with daySpread 1.25 the 10-90% range held about 8 of 10 real outcomes, weekday averages picked worse days than one flat average (weekdayWeight 0), and the share of futures within nearTol (5%) of the best start day matched how often that really happened. seasonShrink 0.25: the factor from the same weeks a year ago keeps a quarter of the difference; with the itemshop.gg history (from May 2025) it beat both no season factor and 0.5 in back-tests on May-Nov 2026.
